test_cases.title: Vice President, Data Analytics & AI
test_cases.description: Enterprise-wide mandate reporting to the CIO. Own the enterprise data and AI strategy, AI operating model, data governance, analytics modernization, Databricks platform roadmap, investment portfolio, and a multi-disciplinary leadership team. Partner with the CFO and executive committee to deliver measurable productivity and business outcomes.
test_cases.rationale: Gold-standard cross-functional executive role combining enterprise Data, AI, Analytics, Governance, Platform, Finance partnership, and transformation ownership.

test_cases.title: Vice President, Finance Transformation & AI
test_cases.description: Report to the CFO and lead a global finance transformation spanning FP&A, ERP transformation, enterprise automation, generative AI, operating model redesign, and benefits realization across multiple business units. Build and lead the transformation office and present progress to the executive committee.
test_cases.rationale: Excellent Finance, AI, automation, operating-model, and enterprise transformation alignment at the target level.

test_cases.title: Head of AI Transformation
test_cases.description: Set enterprise AI strategy and lead the AI operating model, responsible AI governance, generative AI portfolio, workflow automation, investment roadmap, and value realization. Advise the C-suite and scale a cross-functional centre of excellence.
test_cases.rationale: Direct match for enterprise AI transformation, governance, automation, executive exposure, and organizational leadership.

test_cases.title: Chief Data and Analytics Officer
test_cases.description: Own the enterprise data strategy, analytics operating model, data governance, cloud data platform, and global function. Report to the CEO, advise the board, and lead a multi-year roadmap linking data investment to profitability and customer outcomes.
test_cases.rationale: Chief-level enterprise Data and Analytics mandate with governance, platforms, executive exposure, and business accountability.

test_cases.title: Senior Director, Data & AI
test_cases.description: Lead enterprise data products, AI strategy, model governance, Databricks modernization, and a multi-disciplinary team. Partner with executive leadership and Finance on the strategic roadmap, investment business cases, and benefits realization.
test_cases.rationale: Strong target-level role with meaningful enterprise scope, although one level below VP or Chief.

test_cases.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Analytics
test_cases.description: Own analytics strategy and performance management across multiple business units. The role reports to a Vice President.
test_cases.rationale: Strong Analytics leadership with enterprise breadth, but less transformation detail and executive authority than the highest-priority roles.

test_cases.title: Director, Enterprise Data Governance
test_cases.description: Lead the company-wide data governance operating model, data stewardship function, privacy and controls framework, and a team serving multiple business units. Present roadmap decisions to the executive committee and partner with the data platform organization.
test_cases.rationale: Selectively relevant Director role because enterprise scope, team leadership, governance ownership, and executive exposure compensate for title level.

test_cases.title: Director, Technology Modernization
test_cases.description: Own a multi-year technology modernization roadmap across finance systems, cloud data platforms, and workflow automation. Coordinate multiple business units and develop investment business cases, but report through a Vice President rather than directly to the C-suite.
test_cases.rationale: Plausible transformation mandate with relevant platforms and Finance exposure, but less senior executive access.

test_cases.title: Director, FP&A
test_cases.description: Lead annual planning and forecasting, management reporting, budgeting, and business partnership. Manage a small team and support the CFO, with no stated transformation, automation, data-platform, or enterprise technology mandate.
test_cases.rationale: Relevant Finance leadership but missing the cross-functional transformation, AI, governance, and enterprise platform differentiation.

test_cases.title: Head of Data Science
test_cases.description: Player-coach role with no direct reports initially. Train and deploy machine learning models, perform feature engineering, write production code daily, and contribute hands-on to algorithm development.
test_cases.rationale: Inflated leadership title for a primarily hands-on individual-contributor technical role.

test_cases.title: Vice President, Data Engineering
test_cases.description: Set the cloud data platform roadmap and lead data engineering teams. Own software delivery, developer productivity, production reliability, and hands-on technical architecture for large-scale pipelines and developer tooling.
test_cases.rationale: Executive title and platform scope are relevant, but the mandate is engineering-delivery-heavy and lacks Murat's strongest cross-functional differentiators.

test_cases.title: Senior Data Scientist
test_cases.description: Build predictive models, perform feature engineering and model training, and maintain dashboards for marketing teams. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.
test_cases.rationale: Hands-on data-science individual-contributor role rather than executive transformation leadership.

test_cases.title: Machine Learning Engineer
test_cases.description: Train and deploy machine learning models, write production code, develop algorithms, and operate model-serving infrastructure as an individual contributor.
test_cases.rationale: Technical implementation role outside the target leadership positioning.

test_cases.title: Software Engineering Manager
test_cases.description: Manage an application engineering squad, own sprint delivery, conduct code reviews, and develop production software. The role has no enterprise data, AI, Finance, Governance, or transformation mandate.
test_cases.rationale: People management does not compensate for the wrong software-delivery job family.

test_cases.title: Marketing Analytics Manager
test_cases.description: Maintain dashboards, measure advertising campaigns, improve customer acquisition, and support growth marketing reporting as an individual contributor.
test_cases.rationale: Misleading Analytics overlap, but wrong function, level, and mandate.

test_cases.title: Junior FP&A Analyst
test_cases.description: Prepare recurring reports, support budgeting, update forecasts, and perform variance analysis under a Finance Manager.
test_cases.rationale: Relevant Finance terminology but clearly junior and execution-oriented.

test_cases.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Data Platform
test_cases.description: Own a named-account territory, carry a revenue quota, lead sales cycles, and sell enterprise data platform and AI solutions to C-suite buyers.
test_cases.rationale: Contains enterprise Data, AI, and executive language but is a quota-carrying sales role.

test_cases.title: Transformation Program Manager - 12 Month Contract
test_cases.description: Coordinate a finance systems transformation, maintain the program plan, track workstreams, prepare executive status reports, and manage project risks in a fixed-term contract role.
test_cases.rationale: Adjacent transformation content but below the target mandate and penalized for program-management and contract scope.

test_cases.title: Director, AI Product Management
test_cases.description: Own the consumer product roadmap, write product requirements, manage feature delivery, and improve customer acquisition using AI-enabled product capabilities.
test_cases.rationale: Senior AI-adjacent title, but product delivery and customer-acquisition mandate do not match enterprise transformation leadership.
